chapters.title: Hello
chapters.text: At compile time a helper writes a door book for your robot brain. At play time the brick only stores door numbers.

chapters.title: Scan
chapters.text: The generator finds your partial Context, your Execute Node methods, and public built-in methods from Grove.

chapters.title: Write
chapters.text: It writes Create, Update, Set Chunk Generated, plus big switches for Execute and Data, and debug doors when instrumentation is on.

chapters.title: Play
chapters.text: Play time: brick says Type, book opens that case, method runs. Built-in toys like Composite live in your book too.
